title: B.Sc. in Mathematics
description: Students admitted to the Mathematics Programme through the broad-based admission scheme are automatically placed in Mathematics Stream. A student who plans to graduate in any other stream(s) may select the relevant courses as prescribed below, and apply at the final year of attendance to specialize in the stream(s) concerned. To specialize in the Enrichment Stream at their final year of attendance, such a student must also have obtained a Cumulative Major GPA of 3.3 or above, or the preceding two semesters’ Major GPA of 3.3 or above. Students admitted to the Enrichment Mathematics Programme are automatically placed in the Enrichment Stream; so no declaration is required. Students are required to complete a minimum of 71 units of courses as follows:

Students specialized in Mathematics-Education Stream may declare at most one extra stream from (1) Computational and Applied Mathematics Stream, (2) Computational Big Data Analytics Stream, (3) Mathematics-Multidisciplinary Stream or (4) Science, Technology And Research Stream. Students who have satisfied the requirements of both streams will be allowed to graduate with double streams.

Students specialized in Enrichment Stream may declare at most one extra stream from (1) Computational and Applied Mathematics Stream, (2) Computational Big Data Analytics Stream, (3) Mathematics-Education Stream, (4) Mathematics-Multidisciplinary Stream or (5) Science, Technology And Research Stream. Students who have satisfied the requirements of both streams will be allowed to graduate with double streams.
Students shall declare the subject area(s) at least one term before graduation.
